title: Incident v1
description: One problem seen by a module's guardian watchdog (owner decision 2026-10-27: a guardian per module, G0-G3). A check command prints a JSON list of these; an empty list means healthy. Same key across passes = same incident.

key.description: Stable identity of the problem inside the module

kind.description: Module vocabulary: service_down, backup_stale, egress_violation, source_stale…

summary.description: One sentence for the owner, no secret

evidence.description: Measured facts behind the incident, no secret

suggested_level.description: G0 observe, G1 routine reversible action, G2 controlled repair on a copy with checkpoint, G3 owner only
